item.title: Moe Mama! ~Cutie Mama Came Suddenly...~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tarte
  • 発売日: 2006-04-14
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: もえママ! ～Cutie MaMa came Suddenly…～
  • 英語名: Moe Mama! Cutie Mama Came Suddenly…

あらすじ

Main character lives alone due to parents circumstances, so he has a longing for family harmony. His female childhood friend becomes really popular at school, so he feels inferiority compared to her.

One day he returns home and discovers a cute little girl waiting for him.

“Welcome home, Ma-kun! Dinner will be ready soon”.

item.title: Hinatabokko
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tarte
  • 発売日: 2004-07-23
  • スコア: 6.4799999999999995/10 (1267 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ひなたぼっこ
  • 英語名: Hinatabokko

别名

  • Hinatabokko

あらすじ

Hayami Natsuki is an ordinary college student who lives with his sister. While searching for a part-time job he runs into (another) Natsuki, the manager of a popular coffee shop. Her twin-sister, Hinata, was his teacher, who he once had a crush back in high school. For the sake of the sweet feelings he once had for Hinata, Natsuki ends up taking the job offer at her little coffee shop. He also accepts the offer to live with her. Natsuki starts his new life where he shares the house with a couple more beautiful, attractive members of the opposite sex.

item.title: Negai no Mahou.

  • 発売日: 2003-07-25
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ねがいの魔法。
  • 英語名: Negai no Mahou.

あらすじ

Main character used to make up rules in his childhood and awaited rewards from the fate for remaining true to those small rules. In the corner of his heart he still believes in those small miracles. Between the cute transfer student and the childhood friend seeking for romance, it’s time for magic of wishes.

item.title: Sweet Season
item.description:

  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: すぃ～とし～ずん-SWEET SEASON-
  • 英語名: Sweet Season

别名

  • SuiToshiZun

あらすじ

Yoshinori Asamiya is a high school freshman who is in the shogi club. One day, he meets a girl while she was walking her dog. She’s from a different school, but she’s on the shogi club as well…

That girl was Ayumi Jinguuji, and Yoshinori can’t help but be intrigued about her. Even if at first it was difficult to be her friend, Ayumi seems to have taken a liking to him.
